contentList.content: Harmonize your magical reserves. Expend a spell slot to restore [1] charge of Bardic Inspiration.
Expend higher level spell slots to restore additional Bardic Inspiration charges.
Attack up to [1] enemies within melee reach, or strike the same enemy twice. Deals an extra 1d6 damage.
You regain all of your expended uses of Bardic Inspiration when you finish a Short or Long Rest. In addition, you can expend a spell slot with Font of Inspiration to regain Bardic Inspiration uses.
